title: The Dam Survived — the Valley Didn't

lines: A mountainside collapsed into a reservoir in the Italian Alps.
A giant wave rushed over the dam and destroyed the towns below.
Here's the strange part: the dam itself survived.
The failure was the slope beside the lake.
Filling the reservoir soaked and weakened that rock.
For years it crept, until it slid all at once.
The dam only guided the wave into the valley.
Now reservoir slopes are studied as closely as dams.
